properties.name: blockchain-api.core.validator-zeros
properties.description: How many zeros should hashes have as prefix to be valid.

properties.name: blockchain-api.core.miner-type
properties.description: What type of miner should be used (i.e. single thread, multi-thread using Java API or multi-thread with custom implementation).

properties.name: blockchain-api.core.multi-thread-miner-num-of-threads
properties.description: How many threads should multi-thread miners have. Value will be ignored, if miner type (miner-type) is set to single thread.
